key_insight: The study models a space photovoltaic array to compare operation with and without maximum power point tracking (MPPT) under varying irradiation.
engineering_relevance: The simulation supports assessment of space solar power harvesting, with microwave transmission to Earth discussed as a potential delivery pathway.
method: Simulate a space-suitable PV array in MATLAB/Simulink.
Compare operation with and without MPPT.
Observe system response at different irradiation levels.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports selected comparative simulation results but provides no quantitative performance gains or experimental validation.
watch_item: The abstract describes neither AI methods nor end-to-end validation of microwave power transmission.
paper_title: Space Solar Applications: Simulation with MATLAB-Simulink Environment and Transmission of Solar Power Generated
